notes: Full-time construction materials testing (asphalt and aggregates) at Bli Bli. Previous lab experience is listed but no year minimum; Certificate IV is preferred only. SEEK apply links out. Fit 75 (50 + 15 duty + 10 lane 2).
cover_letter_text:
Hi Downer team,

My name's Marc. I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, and I'd like to start in construction materials testing. Your Bli Bli lab tests asphalt and aggregates for infrastructure work across Queensland, and that is the kind of laboratory role I want to get into.

In the diploma I studied the AS 1289 soil testing standards and kept technical records as part of the civil design work. On site in the Philippines I did inspections and quality checks and wrote up the results. I hold a full Victorian driver's licence and a White Card.

I can move to the Sunshine Coast and start three weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
advert_text:
Develop your laboratory career testing construction materials that support the delivery of essential infrastructure across Queensland.
Downer's Transport & Infrastructure business is seeking a Laboratory Technician to join our team based in Bli Bli on the Sunshine Coast.
In this hands-on role, you will conduct laboratory testing and analysis of construction materials used across infrastructure projects. Your work will help ensure materials meet relevant quality standards, technical requirements and project specifications.
This position may involve occasional travel to nearby operational sites and projects.
About the Role
Your responsibilities will include:
- Conducting laboratory testing and analysis of asphalt, aggregates and other construction materials
- Sampling, preparing and testing materials in accordance with relevant standards and laboratory procedures
- Accurately recording, analysing and reporting test results
- Supporting quality assurance and compliance activities
- Maintaining laboratory equipment and ensuring the laboratory remains safe, clean and organised
- Participating in toolbox talks, safety initiatives and team activities
- Supporting laboratory operations across a variety of projects and operational sites
- Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives within the laboratory.
What You'll Bring
We are looking for someone who has:
- Previous experience working in a construction materials, asphalt, concrete, geotechnical or related laboratory environment
- A Certificate IV in Laboratory Techniques, relevant tertiary qualification or equivalent industry experience, preferred
- A current Driver's Licence
- A Construction White Card, or willingness to obtain one
- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, high-quality results
- Sound computer, documentation and reporting skills
- The ability to work independently and contribute effectively as part of a team
- A strong commitment to safety and Downer's Zero Harm culture.
What's in It for You?
- Permanent full-time employment
- Ongoing training and career development opportunities
- The opportunity to continue developing your technical laboratory capability
- A supportive and experienced team environment
- Exposure to construction materials testing across a range of infrastructure projects
- Access to employee benefits, wellbeing initiatives and lifestyle discounts
- The opportunity to work on major infrastructure projects across Queensland
- Work for a company proudly recognised as a WORK180 Endorsed Employer for All Women
- Be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive workplace.
Apply Now
Click Apply Now to submit your application and join a team helping deliver and maintain essential infrastructure across Australia and New Zealand. 
Downer is an employer that acknowledges and embraces the importance of our people's diverse experiences, talents and cultures. As an inclusive employer, we welcome applications from everyone. 
Please note that screening and interviews may take place before the advertised closing date. Applications may also close earlier than this date.
